# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

The following table describes which versions of SymairaHub receive active
security updates:

| Version | Supported     |
| ------- | ------------- |
| v0.1.x  | ✅ Supported   |
| < 0.1   | ❌ Not supported |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We use **GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting (PVR)** for all security
disclosures. PVR is already enabled for this repository.

To report a vulnerability:

1. Go to the repository's **Security** tab.
2. Click **Report a vulnerability** (under "Private vulnerability reporting").
3. Fill in the details — please include as much information as possible to
   help us triage and fix the issue quickly.

We aim to acknowledge your report within **72 hours** and will keep you
informed of progress toward a fix.

**Do not** file a public GitHub issue or discussion for a security
vulnerability — use PVR instead.

Thank you for helping keep SymairaHub and its users safe.
